newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends lower, Dec dips below 1,150.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends lower, Dec dips below 1,150.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Dec (3rd pos) 1,137 rgt/tonne Sept (south) 1,165
Open/Hi/low 1,155/1,155/1,132 Prev close 1,175
Prev settlement 1,155 * sellers price

PALM OIL FUTURES - Technical selling, lack of leads and weak soyoil dragged down prices at the close. Trading was sluggish with players waiting for fresh September crop estimates from forecaster Ivan Wong on Monday. Dec futures broke the 1,150 level and next support will be 1,130.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market also moved in line with futures with interest confining to selected refined products.
"Third month (Dec futures) broke the 1,150 ringgit level earlier and players seeing that the market lacked strength sold Dec futures to a low of 1,132 ringgit," the dealer said.
By the close of the day, December futures contract was 18 ringgit lower at 1,137 ringgit ($454.62) a tonne. Traders said the trading range for next week is seen at 1,120-1,170.
Trading activity was less active ahead of the weekend, and turnover was 1,554 lots against 3,426 on Thursday.
Morning sentiment was also dampened by falls in soyoil futures in Chicago overnight and lack of fresh tenders.
There were no tenders seen after India's STC bought some quantities of RBD palm olein earlier this week, traders said.
They said the market did not expect many tenders particularly from Pakistan because of its currency devaluation recently.
Cargo surveyor SGS (M) Sdn Bhd said on Friday that Malaysia's September 1-20 palm oil exports were at 413.743 tonnes and this has no impact on the market, traders said.
Physical trading was confined to nearby crude palm oil and selected refined products.
Sep (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,165 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,165 to 1,162.50. Sep (south) saw bids at 1,155.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,145 with bids at 1,140.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,170 ringgit with bids at 1.160 after dealing at 1,165 and 1,170.
Oct (central) saw offers at 1,145 and bids at 1,140 and Nov (south) at 1,170 with bids at 1,162.50.
In refined products, Oct RBD palmoil was offered at $500 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $497.50.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $535, Nov/Dec at $527.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $530. Oct was traded at $535 and Nov/Dec from $530 to $525.
Sep/Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $400 and Nov at $405. Sep/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $335. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.5010 ringgit)
